name: Mac Hotels Limited
summary: Mac Hotels Limited, an Indian enterprise, specializes in the ownership, operation, and management of a variety of hospitality venues, including hotels, restaurants, and resorts. The company provides a comprehensive suite of amenities and services for its patrons, such as an outdoor swimming pool, reception desk, massage treatments, and hairdressing services, in addition to laundry facilities. Guests can also enjoy vocational evening entertainment, on-site dining and bar service, and distinctive boat cruise experiences. Established on December 20, 1990, the company's main office is located in Panaji, India.
